=== EMAIL to guest@example.com
Subject: Your link to put a rego on primary@example.com’s parking permit
Provenance: You received this at guest@example.com because someone shared their visitor parking permit with you by email. p.stonn is a free, unofficial scheduler for City of Stonnington visitor parking permits.

This link from primary@example.com lets you put a rego on their City of Stonnington visitor parking permit (Visitor).

When you arrive, open the link and choose your rego. It stays on the permit until the end of the day.

https://p.stonn.org/g/tok

You can bookmark this link or add it to your phone’s home screen, so that next time it opens in one tap. The same link works every time.

Keep this link to yourself. If you were not expecting it, you can ignore this email.

If you have a visitor permit of your own, p.stonn is free for City of Stonnington residents at p.stonn.org.
